{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0006","text":"Garnet Rollout – Quarterly Stakeholder Review
Thursday, March 14 · 2:00 – 2:30pm
Google Meet: meet.google.com/qrx-tbna-wpe

Organizer: Lars
Guests (18): Bea Abernathy, Rhys Achterberg, Vera Castellano, Hollis Brennan, Ivan Lindqvist, Abebe Haddad, Program Committee, Volunteer Coordination, Development & Grants, Finance Subcommittee

Description:
Per the Friends of Northridge stakeholder engagement protocol (Section 4.2), this session constitutes the required quarterly review for the Garnet rollout. Attendance is strongly encouraged for all designated stakeholders!!

Proposed agenda (subject to revision):
1. Welcome and confirmation of quorum (Lars) – 3 min
2. Phase 1 status recap: site readiness, volunteer onboarding numbers, materials distribution (Bea) – 8 min
3. Finance subcommittee update on expenditure to date vs. allocation (Ivan) – 6 min
4. Development & Grants: reporting timeline for funder (Hollis) – 5 min
5. Decision item: whether to delay the Eastside site launch from April 1 to April 15 pending volunteer background checks (Vera / Rhys) – 5 min
6. Any other business – 3 min

Pre-read: the Phase 1 status deck and the expenditure summary are attached. Please review in advance so we can stay on schedule!!! Items 2–4 will be presented as written and questions may be submitted in the comments section of the deck beforehand.

A formal record of proceedings will be circulated to all guests and filed with the board secretary within five business days.

Thank you all for your continued partnership on this important initiative!!

Please RSVP by Tuesday so that quorum can be confirmed!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0007","text":"Prep sync for Yarrow kickoff!! Emeka: agenda, Wes: roster, Farid: room 🎉
